addr: #24, JP Nagar 9th Phase Bannerghatta Road, Anjanapura, Post, Golahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560108, India

rev.t: Small event venue but maintained neatly. Parking will be tough here, but outdoor events can be hosted properly. The venue has lot of palm trees and covered with bougainvillea. Ambience looks cool here.

A below average function hall to hold small party. This place can handle upto 100 people at once. The facilities are pretty basic. Road side parking makes it more difficult. Ok to host birthday and engagement kind of functions and certainly not for hosting marriages.

Dear Sir/Madam,
